Mesh Msg

group GENERIC_BATTERY_MESH_MSG

Mesh message types used by models.

Defines

GENERIC_BATTERY_TIME_UNKNOWN 0xFFFFFF

Unknown battery time.

GENERIC_BATTERY_LEVEL_100 0x64

Battery level at 100%. 0x65-0xFE are prohibited.

GENERIC_BATTERY_LEVEL_UNKNOWN 0xFF

Unknown battery level.

Enums

Values:

enumerator GENERIC_BATTERY_FLAGS_NOT_PRESENT

Battery not present.

enumerator GENERIC_BATTERY_FLAGS_PRESENT_AND_REMOVABLE

Battery is present and removable.

enumerator GENERIC_BATTERY_FLAGS_PRESENT_AND_NON_REMOVABLE

Battery is present and non-removable.

enumerator GENERIC_BATTERY_FLAGS_PRESENCE_UNKNOWN
